description: This Java class is a Spring MVC Controller named ShopContentController, responsible for handling requests to display content pages based on friendly URLs, retrieving content descriptions from the ContentService, setting page metadata, and returning the appropriate view template.

classes.name: ShopContentController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller for serving content pages based on friendly URLs, integrating with ContentService, and setting page metadata.

methods.name: displayContent
methods.description: Handles HTTP requests for content pages identified by a friendly URL, retrieves content description, sets page information, and returns the view template name.
